newsitem.title: CANADA: Onex's Dura unit buying VOFA.
newsitem.headline: Onex's Dura unit buying VOFA.

text.p: Onex Corp said on Friday its subsidiary, Dura Automotive Systems Inc, will acquire Dusseldorf-based VOFA Group for about C$60 million.
Onex said it would purchase VOFA, with annual revenues of about C$115 million, for about C$60 million, to be paid with about C$47 million in cash and the rest in shares of Dura.

Onex said the cash requirement would be funded through borrowings of Dura with no additional investment required by Onex. The additional shares of Dura to be issued would reduce Onex's ownership interest in the company by about one percent to 19 percent. Onex will retain voting control of Dura.
The acquisition should be completed by the end of the fourth quarter, Onex said.

VOFA has manufacturing facilities in Dusseldorf, Gehren and Daun, Germany and Barcelona, Spain. The company's products are complementary to those of Dura and include shifter cables, barke cables and other light-duty cables for the automotive and industrial markets, Onex said.
